predictions.selection_reason: Configuration setting check -> bypasses authentication when requireAuthentication is false -> could allow unauthorized access
predictions.source_summary: settings.requireAuthentication configuration value (defaults to false), which controls whether authentication is required for non-admin paths
predictions.sink_summary: cb(true) callback that grants access without authentication, allowing request to proceed to next middleware
predictions.guard_summary: Path-based guards: static paths bypass auth; /admin paths always require auth; requireAuthentication setting controls auth for other paths
predictions.risk_pattern: Configuration-controlled authentication bypass: when requireAuthentication=false, non-admin paths skip authentication entirely, allowing unauthenticated access to application functionality
enclosing_conditions: Static path bypass check precedes this condition
predictions.context_summary: The authorize function is called in Express middleware flow. When requireAuthentication=false and path is not /admin, access is granted without authentication checks. This affects all non-admin application routes.
unresolved_facts: Whether there are other authentication mechanisms that might override this bypass
